metadata.value: The Challenge As OneTrust scales its platform and expands globally, our infrastructure must keep pace — growing more automated, more resilient, and more self-service for the engineering teams that depend on it. Today, infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment work is distributed across the R&D organization without a single accountable owner driving strategy, standards, and automation maturity end to end. We're looking for a Director, Infrastructure Engineering to build and lead the team responsible for the infrastructure our products run on — from cloud architecture and CI/CD pipelines to deployment automation and platform reliability. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set the technical direction, build a high-performing team of DevOps and infrastructure automation engineers, and give every engineer at OneTrust faster, safer, more reliable ways to ship. Your Mission In this role, you will: Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment automation across R&D, aligning investment with product and platform growth. Lead, hire, and develop a team of DevOps engineers, infrastructure automation engineers, and deployment engineers, building a strong bench of technical talent across US and India. Drive infrastructure-as-code (IaC) adoption and standards (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to make environment provisioning repeatable, auditable, and self-service for product engineering teams. Own CI/CD pipeline architecture and tooling, reducing deployment friction and time-to-production while improving release reliability and rollback safety. Set the strategy for multi-cloud/hybrid infrastructure management, container orchestration, and platform scalability to support current and future product growth. Partner with Security and Compliance to embed security guardrails, access controls, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO) directly into infrastructure and deployment pipelines. Own infrastructure reliability and observability — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and on-call practices — in partnership with Engineering and SRE stakeholders. Lead cost optimization efforts across cloud spend, right-sizing infrastructure investment against usage and business need. Act as the primary point of escalation and decision-maker for infrastructure, DevOps, and deployment-related incidents and cross-team dependencies. Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Security leadership to represent infrastructure needs in roadmap planning and major technical decisions. Evaluate and select tooling and vendor partnerships that support the team's automation-first, self-service infrastructure vision. You Are A builder who thinks in systems — you see infrastructure as a product that serves internal customers, not just a cost center to keep the lights on. An automation-first leader who instinctively looks to eliminate manual, repeatable work and replace it with reliable, self-service tooling. A calm, decisive operator under pressure — comfortable owning incident response and making fast, well-reasoned calls when systems are down. A people leader who invests in growing engineers' technical depth and career paths, not just managing their day-to-day output. A pragmatic communicator who can translate deep technical tradeoffs into business terms for non-technical stakeholders and executives. Security- and compliance-minded by default, treating guardrails as part of good infrastructure design rather than a separate workstream. Comfortable operating in ambiguity, willing to make and revisit decisions as the organization and its infrastructure needs evolve. Your Experience Includes 12+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or cloud operations, including 4+ years in a people leadership role. Proven experience building and leading DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineering teams, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management. Deep hands-on background with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent). Strong track record architecting and scaling CI/CD pipelines and release automation for enterprise-grade, high-availability software products. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, zero-downtime migrations). Working knowledge of security, compliance, and regulatory frameworks relevant to SaaS infrastructure (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR). Experience managing distributed or globally-located engineering teams (US/India or similar) preferred. Demonstrated success partnering with Engineering, Security, and Product leadership to align infrastructure strategy with business priorities. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

metadata.value: Strength in Trust    Imagine being part of an organization dedicated to unlocking the potential of every company to thrive while championing what's good for both people and the planet. At OneTrust, we leverage cutting-edge technology and a pragmatic approach to privacy, GRC (governance, risk management, and compliance), ethics, and ESG (environmental, social, and governance) to create a straightforward platform that amplifies the global push for Trust Intelligence. OneTrust is a fast-growing SaaS enterprise platform with a strong growth trajectory.  Trust serves as the bedrock of every successful business, and OneTrust delivers the technology that empowers you to transform the promise of trust into reality.    The Challenge   Enterprise Account Executives have a critical role and responsibility to deliver new client acquisition in zero-base accounts, while also ensuring successful relationships and revenue growth with existing customers.    We invest heavily in our Sales Team through demand generation, methodology-driven sales philosophy, weekly sales trainings, customer-driven roadmaps, and a readily-available executive team to help close deals. Our Account Executives have a significant total contract value (TCV) opportunity with uncapped commission!  Your Mission   The Account Executive (AE) is responsible for consistently generating, qualifying, and executing opportunities that solve complex problems to support our customers within a targeted geographic territory in the pursuit of becoming more trusted organizations.  Work effectively in a cross-functional manner with Business Development, Partner Channel, and Solutions Engineering to successfully land and expand key accounts  Utilize two-sided discovery to build relationships, understand the customers’ needs and articulate valuable solutions to ensure OneTrust is viewed as a trusted advisor Understand key competitors and their strategies to clearly differentiate OneTrust’s solutions in the marketplace  Conduct outreach to generate pipeline consistently even when engaged in closing activities  Identify and leverage contributors, leaders, and champions to drive execution of the sales strategy appropriately   You Are   You are someone with a hunting mentality and consultative approach, and you have experience communicating with C-Level Executives effectively. You approach new prospecting and deal-advancing activities with balance, and you are well-disciplined in sales processes and CRM hygiene.   Your experience includes:  Strong experience selling B2B Enterprise-level software or related technologies, ideally 7+ years, but exceptions may be made for the right candidate  Strong track record of performance with landing net new logos using Value Selling while growing and supporting existing key accounts  Previous experience running sales presentation/demos   Familiarity with Salesforce.com or similar CRM solution   Benefits  As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, remote or hybrid workplace flexibility, flexible PTO, equity stock options, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.  Our Commitment to You  When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new industry — Trust. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.  OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.  Resources    Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:  OneTrust Careers on YouTube @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram
